{"in_scope":true,"answer_markdown":"**The post-trade Suitability outcome is pass.** All seven Suitability Rules pass after the proposed trades, with no warnings or breaches.

- **SR-01 Maximum equity share:** pass. Equity is 20.97% against a 30% cap for a conservative Risk Profile.
- **SR-02 Single-position limit:** pass. No single-name positions are held.
- **SR-03 Sector concentration:** pass. Health Care is 6.67% including look-through, against a 30% sector limit.
- **SR-04 Minimum cash reserve:** pass. Cash is 15.51% against a 5% floor and 13.2% liquidity needs.
- **SR-05 Client Restrictions:** pass. No Restriction is violated.
- **SR-06 Horizon check:** pass. The 7-year horizon is not short (under 5).
- **SR-07 Taxable-gain warning:** pass. Unrealised gains in taxable accounts are 8.17% of the Portfolio against a 15% warning line. These gains are not netted against losses.

The post-trade drift for every Asset Class is also within tolerance (status "ok").

This Recommendation is high-impact, so it still needs Advisor and Committee steps.
